name: @hhh/security
description: Security and blockchain module for HHH SecureLog — canonical log hashing, hash chain, Merkle trees, Ed25519 signing, smart-contract anchoring

scripts.test: node --test tests/canonicalJson.test.js tests/hashing.test.js tests/hashChain.test.js tests/merkleTree.test.js tests/keyManager.test.js tests/checkpointService.test.js tests/verifier.test.js
scripts.test:contracts: HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true HARDHAT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=false npx hardhat test --config blockchain/hardhat.config.js
scripts.compile: HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true HARDHAT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=false npx hardhat compile --config blockchain/hardhat.config.js
scripts.deploy:local: HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true HARDHAT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=false npx hardhat run blockchain/scripts/deploy.js --config blockchain/hardhat.config.js
scripts.demo: HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true HARDHAT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=false npx hardhat run scripts/demo.js --config blockchain/hardhat.config.js
